claims.claim_text: At approximately 1920 hours, Officer Corbin and I were dispatched to the front of the Ridgemont Police Department following a 9-1-1 call from a female motorist.
Communications advised that the caller had been followed for approximately five minutes from the 57 freeway.
Officer Corbin and I responded in a single marked patrol vehicle, with Officer Corbin driving and myself in the passenger seat.
The subject was already inside the station lobby speaking with the front desk clerk when we made entry.
I contacted the subject first and asked him to step outside.
The subject was cooperative and calmly walked outside with me.
The subject identified himself and stated that he had followed W-1 because she had cut him off on the freeway and he wanted to exchange insurance information.
Officer Corbin spent approximately ten minutes taking W-1's statement before joining me with the subject.
I then turned my back to the subject briefly to radio dispatch with an update.
During this time, Officer Corbin maintained visual contact with the subject.
After a brief standoff lasting approximately thirty seconds, the subject raised the firearm and fired a single shot that struck the pavement near my feet.
I returned fire, discharging two rounds. Simultaneously, Officer Corbin discharged one round.
We began CPR within approximately one minute of the shooting.
Paramedics from the La Habra Fire Department arrived within five minutes and transported the subject to a local hospital, where he was pronounced deceased approximately two hours later.
One firearm was recovered from the subject: a .40 caliber Glock semi-automatic pistol.
